incidents.symptom: Agent emitted valid SQL but failed to apply migration to isolated tenant schema due to unstated implicit assumption.
incidents.root_cause: Under-specified system prompt regarding tenant schema isolation parameters.
incidents.remediation: Explicit negative boundaries and schema contract injection.

incidents.symptom: Agent B overwrote Agent A's working memory during concurrent shared resource execution.
incidents.root_cause: Absence of optimistic concurrency control or commutative state reducer.
incidents.remediation: Enforce OCC versioning and order-invariant superstep reduction.

incidents.symptom: Agent reported success in chat payload but external database row was never created.
incidents.root_cause: Reliance on agent self-reporting rather than external observable postcondition grader.
incidents.remediation: Independent environment state inspection before task finalization.

methodological_caveats: Evaluates isolated synthetic chain recovery, not domain-general stochastic resilience.
Recovery success rates in synthetic loops cannot be directly extrapolated as unconditional production SLA guarantees.
